name.predicate: Institution source names equal to, beginning with, or containing every distinctive word of the supplied name (case, punctuation, terminal legal form and FCU normalized). Applied to the whole catalog before paging.

searched.meaning: Published lender institution profiles (national research cohort and permitted Florida OFR-licensed companies).

scope.meaning: Institution grain only. A candidate is a name match, not a verified identity relationship or a regulatory finding.

clock.label: Source as-of date
clock.note: The committed identity files do not carry an as-of date; none is invented.

limitations: No institution name in the searched scope matched. Nothing was substituted.
